title: Architecture: control plane, etcd, kubelet, kube-proxy and CNI

videos.script: A cluster has two halves. One half decides. The other half does what was decided. {{halves}} The deciding half is the control plane: an API server, a database called etcd, a scheduler and a controller manager. {{control}} The doing half is every node. Each one runs a kubelet, a container runtime, kube-proxy and a network plugin. {{node}} The surprising part is how they talk. They do not call each other. Every one of them talks to the API server, and nothing else touches etcd. {{talk}} In this lesson you will open the control-plane node of the laptop's cluster, read etcd directly, and watch six events pass a pod from one component to the next. {{chain}} Then you will switch the scheduler off, and see exactly which work stops. {{off}}
